thread:
zoe: Cutting RC for ranking-service sha=5a2f1b3. Change window 2026-03-25 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need QA + perf watch for canary.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC created: rc/5a2f1b3-20260325 (id: 5099). Artifacts pinned: ranking-service:5a2f1b3. Promote: `/deploy promote rc/5099 --env canary --percent 2 --kv-warm`

perf: quick staging smoke OK but p99 latency up ~12% when KV warm hits heavy prefix. Watch model-variant inference tail.

devrel: pasted small trace: ```text
2026-03-24T22:10:12Z WARN model-infer delay=412ms variant=large
2026-03-24T22:10:12Z INFO fallback check passed
```

ops-ml: noted. We have a lighter model-variant tag (ranking-lite:2c3d) that historically holds latency under heavy prefix load.

sheriff-ops: oncall for window. Rollback target pre-approved: ranking-service:4f8b9e7. Rollback cmd ready: `kubectl set image deploy/ranking ranking-service=4f8b9e7 -n prod`

zoe: promoting to canary 2% now. `/deploy promote rc/5099 --env canary --percent 2`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started rc/5099 -> canary (2%). KV warm 45s.

perf: canary running. small error bump 0.2% -> 0.6%, p99 up to +18% at 2% traffic. Correlates with calls hitting model-variant=large.

zoe: rather than full rollback, propose traffic-shim to route heavy model calls to ranking-lite for prod ramp. Command: `/traffic shim add --service ranking --from variant=large --to variant=lite --percent 100 --duration 30m`

ops-ml: approving shim for ramp test. It preserves RC artifacts while reducing tail. If tail remains bad we revert to rollback.

sheriff-ops: agree. executing shim and continuing ramp at 10% with canary variant fallback. If 5xx > 1% for 5m we stop.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Traffic shim applied: large -> lite (100%). Resuming prod ramp: stages 10,50,100. Current stage: 10%. Notifying oncall.

perf: observing p99 drop back near baseline and errors stable 0.2%. No 5xx spike so far.

zoe: continuing to 50% over next 12m. Keep a close watch on model-quality signals (ctr/regen-rate).

devrel: post-check: offline eval shows negligible quality regression for top-5 results. Link: https://redwood.internal/eval/5099-quickcheck

marco: (observing) thanks team. If quality drift appears after 50% we will either (a) remove shim and rollback, or (b) reduce microbatching and retune prefetch.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Stage 50% reached. Monitoring metrics.

sheriff-ops: metrics look stable at 50% for 10m. No abort triggers.

zoe: promoting final 100% now. `/deploy promote rc/5099 --env prod --stages 100`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion to 100% complete. Service running ranking-service:5a2f1b3. Note: traffic-shim is still active for heavy-model calls (large -> lite).

ops-ml: schedule follow-up: re-run inference bench with larger heap and microbatch tuning; consider a second RC with model-variant optimized.

zoe: documenting release note: "Ranking-service: prefix cache + model-variant fallback enabled; used traffic shim during ramp to mitigate inference tail; no DB changes." (link: https://redwood.internal/release/5099)

perf: closing watch. all signals green.

zoe: thanks all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
